    # ------------------------------------------------- agent turn (I4)
    def agent_step(
        self,
        action: str,
        payload: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
        namespace: str = "default",
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """One unified agent turn, dispatched under the service lock (I4).

        The seven actions are the sidecar's public verbs. The response is
        uniform - status, abstained, output, epistemic_receipt - and carries
        exactly ONE receipt per turn, so an external harness can treat every
        action as the same tool call and still get a contiguous hash chain.
        """
        action = str(action or "").strip().lower()
        body = dict(payload or {})
        request = {"action": action, "payload": _clean(body), "namespace": str(namespace)}
        mutating = bool(
            (action == "composite" and str(body.get("mode", "query")) == "ingest")
            or action == "discover"
        )
        lock = self.rw.write_locked() if mutating else self.rw.read_locked()
        with lock:
            if action == "verify":
                output = self.sidecar.verify_claim(
                    str(body.get("claim", "")),
                    kind=str(body.get("kind", "text")),
                    top_k=int(body.get("top_k", 4)),
                    namespace=str(namespace),
                )
                status = str(output.get("status", ""))
                abstained = not bool(output.get("supported", False))
            elif action == "solve":
                if str(body.get("mode", "path")) == "impact":
                    output = self.sidecar.impact(
                        str(body.get("target") or body.get("source", "")),
                        hops=int(body.get("hops", 1)),
                        namespace=str(namespace),
                    )
                else:
                    output = self.sidecar.solve(
                        str(body.get("source", "")),
                        body.get("operators") or [],
                        namespace=str(namespace),
                    )
                abstained = bool(output.get("vetoed", False))
                status = "abstained" if abstained else "answered"
            elif action == "impact":
                output = self.sidecar.impact(
                    str(body.get("target") or body.get("source", "")),
                    hops=int(body.get("hops", 1)),
                    namespace=str(namespace),
                )
                abstained = not bool(output.get("resolved", True))
                status = "abstained" if abstained else "ok"
            elif action == "plan":
                # Call the planner directly: agent_step issues exactly one
                # receipt for the turn, so an inner envelope would break the
                # contiguous 76-query chain.
                if body.get("episode_id"):
                    output = self._plan_episode(
                        body.get("observation"),
                        body.get("history_waves"),
                        str(body.get("transition", "rotor")),
                        int(body.get("lookahead_depth", 2)),
                        float(body.get("gamma_look", 0.02)),
                        str(namespace),
                        True,
                        str(body.get("episode_id")),
                        bool(body.get("reset_episode", False)),
                        bool(body.get("emit_swat_kv", False)),
                        bool(body.get("online_repulsor", False)),
                    )
                else:
                    output = self.sidecar.plan(
                        body.get("observation"),
                        history_waves=body.get("history_waves"),
                        transition=str(body.get("transition", "rotor")),
                        lookahead_depth=int(body.get("lookahead_depth", 2)),
                        gamma_look=float(body.get("gamma_look", 0.02)),
                        namespace=str(namespace),
                    )
                abstained = False
                status = "ok"
            elif action == "synthesize":
                output = self.sidecar.synthesize(
                    str(body.get("intent", "")),
                    kind=str(body.get("kind", "code")),
                    namespace=str(namespace),
                    max_tokens=int(body.get("max_tokens", 320)),
                )
                status = str(output.get("status", ""))
                abstained = status == "refused"
            elif action == "composite":
                inner = self.composite_call(
                    mode=str(body.get("mode", "query")),
                    rules=body.get("rules"),
                    a=body.get("a"),
                    b=body.get("b"),
                    op=body.get("op"),
                    x0=body.get("x0"),
                    x1=body.get("x1"),
                    namespace=str(namespace),
                    _issue_receipt=False,
                )
                output = dict(inner["result"])
                abstained = bool(output.get("abstained", False))
                status = "abstained" if abstained else "ok"
            elif action == "veto":
                task = str(body.get("task", "vision"))
                tensor = self._as_tensor(task, body.get("x"))
                output = self.sidecar.veto_check(task, tensor)
                abstained = False
                status = "ok"
            elif action == "telepathy":
                # Directive P2: the same two modes the REST route serves.
                output = self.telepathy(
                    mode=str(body.get("mode", "ingest_chunks")),
                    session_id=body.get("session_id"),
                    namespace=str(namespace),
                    chunks=body.get("chunks"),
                    query=body.get("query"),
                    budget_u=int(body.get("budget_u", 32)),
                    per_chunk_u=int(body.get("per_chunk_u", 8)),
                    hops=int(body.get("hops", 3)),
                    top_k=int(body.get("top_k", 1)),
                    reset=bool(body.get("reset", False)),
                )
                if str(body.get("mode", "ingest_chunks")).startswith("query"):
                    abstained = not bool(output.get("answer"))
                    status = "answered" if not abstained else "abstained"
                else:
                    abstained = int(output.get("admitted_chunks", 0)) == 0
                    status = "ok" if not abstained else "abstained"
            elif action == "turing":
                # Directive S2: one wave-space program execution per turn. The
                # inner call is issued without its own receipt so the turn keeps
                # exactly one link in the chain.
                output = self.turing(
                    mode=str(body.get("mode", "run")),
                    program=str(body.get("program", "binary_increment")),
                    tape=body.get("tape"),
                    max_steps=int(body.get("max_steps", 0)),
                    namespace=str(namespace),
                    examples=body.get("examples"),
                    alphabet=body.get("alphabet"),
                    name=str(body.get("name", "induction")),
                )
                inner = dict(output.get("result") or {})
                output = inner
                abstained = bool(inner.get("vetoed", False)) or (
                    str(body.get("mode", "run")) == "run" and not inner.get("halted", False)
                )
                status = "abstained" if abstained else "ok"
            elif action == "discover":
                # Directive P4: a real discovery tick, no envelope inside the
                # turn (agent_step issues exactly one receipt).
                engine = self.sidecar._ensure_engine(str(namespace))
                engine.namespace = str(namespace)
                engine.plans.namespace = str(namespace)
                output = engine.holonic_discover(
                    str(body.get("intent", "")),
                    str(body.get("tests", "")),
                    dict(body.get("request") or {}),
                    library=body.get("library"),
                )
                abstained = not bool(output.get("verified", False))
                status = "accepted" if not abstained else "refused"
            else:
                raise ValueError(
                    "action must be one of verify, solve, impact, plan, "
                    "synthesize, composite, veto, telepathy, discover, turing"
                )
            result = {
                "status": status,
                "abstained": bool(abstained),
                "output": _clean(output),
            }
            receipt = self.ledger.issue(
                "/v1/holarch/agent_step", request, result, config_digest=self.config_digest
            )
            receipt["checkpoint_sha256"] = str(
                self.checkpoint_info.get("sha256", "") or ""
            )
            return {
                "ok": True,
                "endpoint": "/v1/holarch/agent_step",
                "status": status,
                "abstained": bool(abstained),
                "output": _clean(output),
                "epistemic_receipt": receipt,
            }

    # --------------------------------------------------- chat adapter (J4)
    def _chat_payload(
        self, action: str, text: str, metadata: Dict[str, Any]
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        raw = metadata.get("payload")
        payload: Dict[str, Any] = dict(raw) if isinstance(raw, dict) else {}
        if action == "verify":
            payload.setdefault("claim", text)
            if not payload.get("kind"):
                payload["kind"] = "code" if looks_like_code(text) else "text"
        elif action == "impact":
            payload.setdefault("target", extract_chat_target(text))
            payload.setdefault("hops", 1)
        elif action == "plan":
            payload.setdefault("observation", [0.0] * int(getattr(self.cfg, "obs_dim", 79)))
            payload.setdefault("transition", "shift")
        elif action == "solve":
            payload.setdefault("source", extract_chat_target(text))
            payload.setdefault("operators", [])
        elif action == "synthesize":
            payload.setdefault("intent", text)
            payload.setdefault("kind", "code")
        elif action == "composite":
            payload.setdefault("mode", "query")
        elif action == "veto":
            payload.setdefault("task", "vision")
        elif action == "turing":
            payload.setdefault("mode", "run")
            payload.setdefault("program", "binary_increment")
        return payload

    def chat_completion(
        self,
        model: str = "henri-holarch",
        messages: Optional[Sequence[Any]] = None,
        tools: Optional[Sequence[Any]] = None,
        metadata: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """One OpenAI-compatible turn over one epistemic agent_step.

        The action is chosen deterministically, routed through agent_step,
        and reported twice: once inside the agent envelope and once in the
        OpenAI-shaped body. The chat response carries its own receipt, whose
        parent is the agent receipt when an agent turn ran.
        """
        message_list = list(messages or [])
        meta = dict(metadata) if isinstance(metadata, dict) else {}
        namespace = str(meta.get("namespace") or "default")
        action = select_chat_action(message_list, tools, meta)
        text = chat_text(message_list)
        payload = self._chat_payload(action, text, meta)
        status = "ok"
        abstained = False
        output: Any = None
        agent_receipt: Dict[str, Any] = {}
        error = ""
        if action == "composite" and not any(
            payload.get(key) is not None for key in ("a", "b", "x0", "x1")
        ):
            error = "composite needs a, b and op in metadata.payload"
        else:
            try:
                envelope = self.agent_step(action, payload, namespace)
            except (ValueError, KeyError, TypeError) as exc:
                error = str(exc)
            else:
                status = str(envelope.get("status", ""))
                abstained = bool(envelope.get("abstained", False))
                output = envelope.get("output")
                agent_receipt = dict(envelope.get("epistemic_receipt") or {})
        if error:
            status, abstained = "error", True
            output = {"error": error, "action": action}
        refused = bool(abstained) or status in _CHAT_REFUSAL_STATUSES
        content = chat_content(action, output, refused)
        prompt_tokens = sum(
            len(chat_message_text(_chat_message_field(message, "content", "")).split())
            for message in message_list
        )
        completion_tokens = len(content.split())
        receipt = self.ledger.issue(
            "/v1/chat/completions",
            {
                "model": str(model),
                "action": action,
                "namespace": namespace,
                "messages": [
                    {
                        "role": str(_chat_message_field(message, "role", "user")),
                        "content": chat_message_text(
                            _chat_message_field(message, "content", "")
                        ),
                    }
                    for message in message_list
                ],
            },
            {
                "action": action,
                "content": content,
                "status": status,
                "abstained": bool(refused),
                "namespace": namespace,
                "agent_receipt": str(agent_receipt.get("sha256", "") or ""),
            },
            config_digest=self.config_digest,
        )
        return {
            "id": "chatcmpl-" + str(receipt["sha256"])[:24],
            "object": "chat.completion",
            "created": int(time.time()),
            "model": str(model),
            "choices": [
                {
                    "index": 0,
                    "message": {"role": "assistant", "content": content},
                    "finish_reason": "stop",
                }
            ],
            "usage": {
                "prompt_tokens": int(prompt_tokens),
                "completion_tokens": int(completion_tokens),
                "total_tokens": int(prompt_tokens + completion_tokens),
            },
            "epistemic_receipt": receipt,
            "holarch": {
                "action": action,
                "status": status,
                "abstained": bool(refused),
                "result": _clean(output),
                "agent_receipt": agent_receipt or None,
                "checkpoint_sha256": str(self.checkpoint_info.get("sha256", "") or ""),
            },
        }

    def export_import_bundle(
        self, src_ns: str = "default", dst_ns: str = "imported"
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Copy one tenant's vocabulary ledger and plan library to another.

        Directive K4. The bundle carries the exact identifier order and the
        Tier-2 address map, so the destination namespace can answer with the
        source tenant's token ids without re-tokenizing a string. The
        rebase id map is produced by rebase_tenant_vocabulary when the caller
        holds two live tokenizers; this method moves the durable records.
        """
        from henri.holarch.code_lang import VOCAB_LEDGER_KIND

        memory = getattr(self.sidecar.model, "memory", None)
        if memory is None:
            raise ValueError("the service has no Zone C memory")
        source = str(src_ns or "default")
        dest = str(dst_ns or "imported")
        ledger = memory.get_meta(source, VOCAB_LEDGER_KIND, "vocab_ledger")
        tier2 = memory.get_meta(source, VOCAB_LEDGER_KIND, "vocab_ledger_tier2")
        plans = memory.get_meta(source, "plan")
        written = 0
        if ledger:
            memory.put_meta(dest, VOCAB_LEDGER_KIND, "vocab_ledger", dict(ledger[-1][1]))
            written += 1
        if tier2:
            memory.put_meta(dest, VOCAB_LEDGER_KIND, "vocab_ledger_tier2", dict(tier2[-1][1]))
            written += 1
        for key, payload in plans:
            memory.put_meta(dest, "plan", str(key), dict(payload))
            written += 1
        tier2_ids = list(dict(tier2[-1][1]).get("tier2_ids", [])) if tier2 else []
        result = {
            "source": source,
            "destination": dest,
            "ledger_records": len(ledger),
            "tier2_records": len(tier2),
            "plan_records": len(plans),
            "tier2_ids": len(tier2_ids),
            "written": int(written),
            "ledger_digest": str(
                dict(ledger[-1][1]).get("digest", "") if ledger else ""
            ),
            "plans": [str(key) for key, _payload in plans],
        }
        self._mark_state()
        return self._envelope("/v1/holarch/bundle", {"src": source, "dst": dest}, result)

    def health(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        with self._read_scope():
            rotor = getattr(self.sidecar.model, "action_rotor", None)
            ledger_state = self.ledger.snapshot()
            result = {
                "status": "ok",
                "config_digest": self.config_digest,
                "parameters": float(self.sidecar.model.parameter_count()),
                "receipts": float(ledger_state["count"]),
                "chain_head": ledger_state["head"],
                "chain_valid": bool(ledger_state["chain_valid"]),
                "checkpoint": dict(self.checkpoint_info),
                "rotor": dict(getattr(rotor, "state", lambda: {})())
                if rotor is not None
                else None,
                "lock": self.rw.stats(),
                "rate_limit": self.limiter.stats(),
            }
            return self._envelope("/v1/holarch/health", {}, result)

    def close(self) -> None:
        try:
            self.sidecar.close()
        finally:
            if self._pinned_threads:
                torch.set_num_threads(self._saved_threads)
                self._pinned_threads = False

_UNSET: Any = object()


def _authorized(header: Any, keys: Set[str]) -> bool:
    """True when the header carries one of the configured Bearer tokens."""
    if not keys:
        return True
    text = str(header or "").strip()
    if not text:
        return False
    scheme, _, token = text.partition(" ")
    if scheme.lower() != "bearer":
        return False
    token = token.strip()
    if not token:
        return False
    return any(hmac.compare_digest(token, str(key)) for key in keys)


def _env_api_keys() -> Set[str]:
    """HENRI_API_KEYS (comma separated) plus HENRI_API_KEY, read once."""
    keys: Set[str] = set()
    for part in str(os.environ.get("HENRI_API_KEYS", "")).replace("\n", ",").split(","):
        if part.strip():
            keys.add(part.strip())
    single = str(os.environ.get("HENRI_API_KEY", "")).strip()
    if single:
        keys.add(single)
    return keys


def _namespace_from_body(body: bytes) -> str:
    """The bucket key: the request namespace, else the chat metadata one."""
    if not body:
        return "default"
    try:
        payload = json.loads(body)
    except Exception:
        return "default"
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        return "default"
    namespace = payload.get("namespace")
    if namespace:
        return str(namespace)
    metadata = payload.get("metadata")
    if isinstance(metadata, dict) and metadata.get("namespace"):
        return str(metadata["namespace"])
    return "default"


async def _send_json(send: Any, status: int, payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    body = json.dumps(payload, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")
    await send(
        {
            "type": "http.response.start",
            "status": int(status),
            "headers": [
                (b"content-type", b"application/json"),
                (b"content-length", str(len(body)).encode("latin-1")),
            ],
        }
    )
    await send({"type": "http.response.body", "body": body, "more_body": False})


class EpistemicGateMiddleware:
    """Bearer auth and the per-namespace token bucket, ahead of routing.

    /healthz is public and unlimited. Every /v1/* request is checked for a
    key (when any are configured) and then charged to its namespace bucket,
    so a refused call never reaches a model. The body is read once and
    replayed to the router, which is how the namespace is known before the
    endpoint's request model has parsed it.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        app: Any,
        *,
        api_keys: Optional[Set[str]] = None,
        limiter: Optional[RateLimiter] = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.app = app
        self.api_keys = {str(key) for key in (api_keys or ())}
        self.limiter = limiter if limiter is not None else RateLimiter(rps=None)

    async def __call__(self, scope: Any, receive: Any, send: Any) -> None:
        if scope.get("type") != "http":
            await self.app(scope, receive, send)
            return
        path = str(scope.get("path", "") or "")
        if not path.startswith("/v1/"):
            await self.app(scope, receive, send)
            return
        headers = {
            bytes(name).decode("latin-1").lower(): bytes(value).decode("latin-1")
            for name, value in (scope.get("headers") or [])
        }
        if self.api_keys and not _authorized(headers.get("authorization"), self.api_keys):
            await _send_json(send, 401, {"ok": False, "error": "unauthorized"})
            return
        body = b""
        more = True
        while more:
            message = await receive()
            if message.get("type") != "http.request":
                await _send_json(send, 400, {"ok": False, "error": "bad_request"})
                return
            body += message.get("body", b"") or b""
            more = bool(message.get("more_body", False))
        if self.limiter.enabled and not self.limiter.take(_namespace_from_body(body)):
            await _send_json(send, 429, {"ok": False, "error": "rate_limited"})
            return

        replayed = False

        async def replay() -> Dict[str, Any]:
            nonlocal replayed
            if not replayed:
                replayed = True
                return {"type": "http.request", "body": body, "more_body": False}
            # Directive Z4: a streaming response keeps a listener on receive
            # and stops the stream when it sees http.disconnect. Delegating the
            # later reads to the real channel keeps that listener honest
            # instead of handing it a synthetic disconnect before the body has
            # been delivered. A blocking response never reads receive twice,
            # so the non-stream path is untouched.
            return await receive()

        await self.app(scope, replay, send)


def build_app(
    service: Optional[SidecarService] = None,
    *,
    api_keys: Optional[Set[str]] = None,
    rate_limit_rps: Any = _UNSET,
    rate_limit_burst: Any = _UNSET,
    clock: Optional[Callable[[], float]] = None,
):
    """Build the FastAPI app. Imported lazily so the core stays light.

    Auth and rate limiting are configuration, not new routes. Pass api_keys
    (or set HENRI_API_KEYS / HENRI_API_KEY) to require a Bearer token, and
    rate_limit_rps / rate_limit_burst to shape the per-namespace bucket;
    rate_limit_rps=None disables the bucket. _UNSET keeps the service's own
    values, so an already-configured service is never silently overridden.
    """
    from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException

    if service is None:
        service = SidecarService(
            api_keys=api_keys,
            rate_limit_rps=50.0 if rate_limit_rps is _UNSET else rate_limit_rps,
            rate_limit_burst=100.0 if rate_limit_burst is _UNSET else rate_limit_burst,
            clock=clock,
        )
    elif rate_limit_rps is not _UNSET or rate_limit_burst is not _UNSET or clock is not None:
        service.clock = clock or service.clock
        service.limiter = RateLimiter(
            rps=service.limiter.rps if rate_limit_rps is _UNSET else rate_limit_rps,
            burst=service.limiter.burst if rate_limit_burst is _UNSET else rate_limit_burst,
            clock=service.clock,
        )

    configured_keys: Set[str] = {str(key) for key in (api_keys or ()) if str(key)}
    if not configured_keys:
        configured_keys = set(service.api_keys)
    if not configured_keys:
        configured_keys = _env_api_keys()

    app = FastAPI(
        title="HENRI holarch epistemic sidecar",
        version="1.0",
        description="Fail-closed veto, symbolic solve, playbook, and rule adaptation, each with a SHA-256 receipt.",
    )
    app.add_middleware(
        EpistemicGateMiddleware, api_keys=configured_keys, limiter=service.limiter
    )
    app.state.epistemic_service = service
    app.state.api_keys = configured_keys
    app.state.rate_limiter = service.limiter

    def get_service() -> SidecarService:
        nonlocal service
        if service is None:
            service = SidecarService()
        return service

    @app.get("/healthz")
    def healthz():
        return get_service().health()

    @app.post("/v1/holarch/veto")
    def veto(request: VetoRequest):
        return get_service().veto(request.task, request.x, request.rule_id, request.namespace)

    @app.post("/v1/holarch/ingest_code")
    def ingest_code(request: IngestCodeRequest):
        try:
            return get_service().ingest_code(
                request.root,
                request.package,
                request.namespace,
                request.mode,
                request.file_path,
                request.source_text,
            )
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc))

    @app.post("/v1/holarch/plan")
    def plan(request: PlanRequest):
        try:
            return get_service().plan(
                request.observation,
                request.history_waves,
                request.transition,
                request.lookahead_depth,
                request.gamma_look,
                request.namespace,
                request.batch_rollout,
                request.episode_id,
                request.online_repulsor,
                request.reset_episode,
                request.emit_swat_kv,
            )
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc))

    @app.post("/v1/holarch/verify")
    def verify(request: VerifyRequest):
        return get_service().verify(
            request.claim, request.kind, request.top_k, request.namespace
        )

    @app.post("/v1/holarch/ingest_edges")
    def ingest_edges(request: IngestEdgesRequest):
        return get_service().ingest_edges(request.edges, request.namespace)

    @app.post("/v1/holarch/solve")
    def solve(request: SolveRequest):
        return get_service().solve(
            request.source, request.operators, request.namespace, request.mode
        )

    @app.post("/v1/holarch/synthesize")
    def synthesize(request: SynthesizeRequest):
        return get_service().synthesize(
            request.intent, request.kind, request.namespace, request.max_tokens
        )

    @app.post("/v1/holarch/telepathy")
    def telepathy(request: TelepathyRequest):
        try:
            return get_service().telepathy(
                mode=request.mode,
                session_id=request.session_id,
                namespace=request.namespace,
                chunks=request.chunks,
                query=request.query,
                budget_u=request.budget_u,
                per_chunk_u=request.per_chunk_u,
                hops=request.hops,
                top_k=request.top_k,
                reset=request.reset,

            )
        except KeyError as exc:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=str(exc))
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc))

    @app.post("/v1/holarch/turing")
    def turing(request: TuringRequest):
        try:
            return get_service().turing(
                request.mode,
                request.program,
                request.tape,
                request.max_steps,
                request.namespace,
                request.examples,
                request.alphabet,
                request.name,
            )
        except KeyError as exc:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=str(exc))
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc))

    @app.post("/v1/holarch/discover")
    def discover(request: DiscoverRequest):
        try:
            return get_service().discover(
                request.intent,
                request.tests,
                request.request,
                request.namespace,
                request.library,
            )
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc))

    @app.post("/v1/holarch/playbook")
    def playbook(request: PlaybookRequest):
        return get_service().playbook(
            request.name, request.steps, request.merge, request.namespace
        )

    @app.post("/v1/holarch/adapt_rule")
    def adapt_rule(request: AdaptRuleRequest):
        return get_service().adapt_rule(
            request.task, request.x, request.y, request.rule_id, request.lr, request.namespace
        )

    @app.post("/v1/holarch/composite")
    def composite(request: CompositeRequest):
        rules = None if request.rules is None else [rule.model_dump() for rule in request.rules]
        try:
            return get_service().composite_call(
                mode=request.mode,
                rules=rules,
                a=request.a,
                b=request.b,
                op=request.op,
                x0=request.x0,
                x1=request.x1,
                namespace=request.namespace,
            )
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc))

    @app.post("/v1/holarch/agent_step")
    def agent_step(request: AgentStepRequest):
        try:
            return get_service().agent_step(
                request.action, request.payload, request.namespace
            )
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc))

    @app.post("/v1/chat/completions")
    def chat_completions(request: ChatCompletionRequest):
        from fastapi.responses import StreamingResponse

        payload = get_service().chat_completion(
            request.model,
            [message.model_dump() for message in request.messages],
            request.tools,
            request.metadata,
        )
        if not bool(request.stream):
            return payload
        lines = chat_stream_chunks(payload)

        def events():
            for line in lines:
                yield line + "\n\n"

        return StreamingResponse(
            events(),
            media_type="text/event-stream",
            headers={"cache-control": "no-cache", "x-accel-buffering": "no"},
        )

    @app.get("/v1/holarch/receipt")
    def receipts(limit: int = 16):
        ledger = get_service().ledger
        state = ledger.snapshot()
        return {
            "count": state["count"],
            "head": state["head"],
            "chain_valid": state["chain_valid"],
            "receipts": ledger.receipts[-max(1, int(limit)):],
        }

    return app


def serve_rest(host: str = "127.0.0.1", port: int = 8080, **kwargs) -> None:
    """Run the REST service with uvicorn."""
    import uvicorn

    app = build_app(SidecarService(**kwargs))
    uvicorn.run(app, host=str(host), port=int(port), log_level="info")

"""The HENRI agentic sidecar: epistemic brain, memory, router, verifier.

Evidence label: DERIVED for the wiring, OBSERVED for every number a run
records.

What this module is
-------------------
A thin, sovereign wrapper that any agent can call. It does not generate
prose. It answers four questions an agentic system actually needs:

    is this input inside the manifold?          veto_check
    what does this unseen system do?            solve / ingest
    what did we already learn about this rule?  recall_prototype / adapt_rule
    what is the current strategy for this task? compile_playbook / recall

The four zones keep their responsibilities: Zone C stores engrams and
prototypes, Zone B supplies the Sagnac statistic, Zone A carries the
plasticity, and slot 3 carries the rule context. Nothing here bypasses
them.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import ast
import hashlib
import json
import math
import tempfile
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Callable, Dict, Iterable, List, Optional, Sequence, Tuple

import numpy as np
import torch

from henri.holarch.config import HolarchConfig, TASK_IDS
from henri.holarch.pipeline import HenriHolarch
from henri.holarch.symbolic import (
    CodeGraphIndexer,
    Edge,
    SolveResult,
    SymbolCodebook,
    SymbolicDecoder,
    TopologySolver,
    index_code,
)

_EPS = 1e-12


def _wave_tensor(wave: Sequence[float], dim: int) -> torch.Tensor:
    """One caller-supplied wave as a complex torch row.

    Two encodings are accepted, both lossless: 2*D floats interleaved as
    (real, imaginary), or D real floats. Anything else is a caller error
    and is refused rather than truncated.
    """
    values = np.asarray(wave, dtype=np.float64).reshape(-1)
    dim = int(dim)
    if values.size == 2 * dim:
        pairs = values.reshape(dim, 2)
        data = pairs[:, 0] + 1j * pairs[:, 1]
    elif values.size == dim:
        data = values.astype(np.complex64)
    else:
        raise ValueError(
            f"history wave has {values.size} values; expected {dim} or {2 * dim}"
        )
    return torch.from_numpy(np.asarray(data, dtype=np.complex64).reshape(1, dim))


def _unit(vector: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    norm = float(np.linalg.norm(vector))
    return (vector / max(norm, _EPS)).astype(np.complex64)


@dataclass
class Playbook:
    """A compiled execution strategy: exact steps, not free text."""

    name: str
    steps: List[str]
    version: int = 1
    source: str = "manual"

    def render(self, decoder: SymbolicDecoder) -> str:
        return decoder.render_plan(self.name, self.steps, verified=True)


class EpistemicSidecar:
    """One object an agent can hold: memory, verifier, router, solver."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        cfg: Optional[HolarchConfig] = None,
        model: Optional[HenriHolarch] = None,
        backend: str = "sqlite",
        memory_path: Optional[str] = None,
        root: str | Path = ".",
    ) -> None:
        self.cfg = cfg or HolarchConfig.small()
        self.root = Path(root)
        self.indexer: Optional[CodeGraphIndexer] = None
        # Directive I4: one index per tenant. The single-package sidecar had
        # one slot, so mounting a second package silently replaced the first;
        # impact and code verification now select by namespace.
        self._indexers: Dict[str, CodeGraphIndexer] = {}
        self._engine = None
        # Directive Q4: one warm engine per (root, namespace). A discovery
        # tick must not refit the corpus; the entry is invalidated only when
        # the state epoch advances on a code or vocabulary mutation.
        self._engines: Dict[Tuple[str, str], Dict[str, object]] = {}
        path = memory_path or str(
            Path(tempfile.gettempdir()) / f"henri_sidecar_{int(time.time())}.sqlite3"
        )
        self.model = model or HenriHolarch(self.cfg, backend=backend, memory_path=path)
        self.model.eval()
        self.codebook = SymbolCodebook(self.cfg.dim)
        self.solver = TopologySolver(self.model.memory, self.codebook, mode="indexed")
        self.decoder = SymbolicDecoder()
        self.playbooks: Dict[str, Playbook] = {}
        self.index_report: Dict[str, float] = {}
        # Directive N1: one monotonic state epoch per sidecar. Every method
        # that changes what a read would answer advances it, and the service
        # cache key includes it, so a direct sidecar mutation (for example
        # the delta ingest the gauntlet calls without the service wrapper)
        # cannot leave a stale read behind.
        self.state_epoch: int = 0
        # The resident synthesis engine depends on the corpus and the locked
        # vocabulary, not on Zone C rows. A memory write must not force a
        # corpus re-parse; a code or vocabulary ingest still does.
        self._engine_epoch: int = 0
        self._state_listeners: List[Callable[[], None]] = []

    # ------------------------------------------------------- state epoch
    def add_state_listener(self, listener: Callable[[], None]) -> None:
        """Register a callback that runs after every state mutation."""
        if listener not in self._state_listeners:
            self._state_listeners.append(listener)

    def note_state_change(self, invalidate_engines: bool = False) -> None:
        """Advance the epoch, then tell every registered cache to drop."""
        self.state_epoch = int(self.state_epoch) + 1
        # Directive O2: the shared database epoch is what a sibling lane
        # reads, so a mutation in this process invalidates every lane.
        memory = getattr(self.model, "memory", None)
        bumper = getattr(memory, "bump_state_epoch", None)
        if bumper is not None:
            try:
                bumper()
            except Exception:
                pass
        # A code or vocabulary mutation invalidates every warm resident
        # engine: the tokenizer, the projector and the plan store are all
        # properties of the corpus the epoch just moved. A Zone C write does
        # not, so it leaves the engine resident.
        if invalidate_engines:
            self._engines.clear()
            self._engine_epoch = int(self._engine_epoch) + 1
        for listener in list(self._state_listeners):
            try:
                listener()
            except Exception:
                continue

    # ------------------------------------------------------- 1. structural
    def ingest_edges(
        self, edges: Iterable[Edge], calibrate: bool = True, namespace: str = "default"
    ) -> Dict[str, float]:
        """Write a novel system into Zone C. No weight is touched.

        Directive F1: the namespace is part of every write and every
        calibration read, so two tenants cannot share a transition key.
        """
        edges = list(edges)
        for edge in edges:
            self.codebook.add(edge.source)
            self.codebook.add(edge.target)
        before = float(self.model.memory.stats()["count"])
        written = self.solver.ingest(edges, namespace=str(namespace))
        report = {
            "edges_ingested": float(written),
            "engrams_before": before,
            "engrams_after": float(self.model.memory.stats()["count"]),
            "parameters_unchanged": 1.0,
            "namespace": str(namespace),
        }
        if calibrate and edges:
            report.update(self.solver.calibrate(edges, namespace=str(namespace)))
        self.note_state_change()
        return report

    def ingest_code(
        self,
        root: str | Path,
        package: str = "henri",
        namespace: str = "default",
        mode: str = "edges",
        file_path: Optional[str] = None,
        source_text: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> Dict[str, float]:
        """Read a package once, then answer from memory only.

        Stage 2: the index pass also extracts every signature and every AST
        parent-child transition and stores them as Tier-3 boundary engrams,
        so the Sagnac gate has an axiom to compare a proposed statement with.

        Directive H4: mode="delta" re-indexes exactly ONE file through
        CodeGraphIndexer.update_file. The per-module records are reused for
        every other file, so an agent edit costs one ast.parse instead of a
        package pass, and the resulting graph is identical to a full index.
        """
        if str(mode) == "delta":
            if file_path is None:
                raise ValueError("mode='delta' needs a file_path")
            indexer = self._indexers.get(str(namespace))
            if indexer is None:
                indexer = CodeGraphIndexer.from_memory(self.model.memory, str(namespace))
            if indexer is None:
                indexer = CodeGraphIndexer(
                    self.model.memory, namespace=str(namespace), symbol_codebook=self.codebook
                )
            report = indexer.update_file(root, file_path, source_text=source_text)
            self.indexer = indexer
            self._indexers[str(namespace)] = indexer
            self._absorb_index_report(report)
            self.index_report["delta"] = 1.0
            self.index_report["delta_seconds"] = float(report.seconds)
            self.index_report["delta_updated"] = float(len(report.updated))
            self.note_state_change(invalidate_engines=True)
            return dict(self.index_report)
        indexer = CodeGraphIndexer(
            self.model.memory, namespace=str(namespace), symbol_codebook=self.codebook
        )
        report = indexer.index(root, package=package)
        self.indexer = indexer
        self._indexers[str(namespace)] = indexer
        graph_edges = list(indexer.graph.edges)
        ingest = self.ingest_edges(graph_edges, namespace=str(namespace))
        self._absorb_index_report(report)
        self.note_state_change(invalidate_engines=True)
        return {**self.index_report, **ingest}

    def mount_indexer(self, indexer, namespace: str = "default") -> Dict[str, object]:
        """Attach an already-built index to one tenant (I4).

        The multi-package benchmark builds a 200+ file workspace index once
        and mounts it; mounting is not an ingest, so it writes no engram and
        moves no receipt.
        """
        self._indexers[str(namespace)] = indexer
        if self.indexer is None:
            self.indexer = indexer
        self.note_state_change(invalidate_engines=True)
        return {
            "namespace": str(namespace),
            "files": int(getattr(indexer.report, "files", 0)),
            "edges": int(getattr(indexer.report, "edges", 0)),
            "nodes": int(getattr(indexer.report, "nodes", 0)),
        }

    def _absorb_index_report(self, report) -> None:
        self.index_report = {
            "files_parsed": float(report.files),
            "lines_parsed": float(report.lines),
            "parse_seconds": float(report.seconds),
            "edges": float(report.edges),
            "nodes": float(report.nodes),
            "signatures": float(report.signatures),
            "grammar_transitions": float(report.transitions),
            "boundary_engrams": float(report.boundary_engrams),
        }

    def impact(self, target: str, hops: int = 1, namespace: str = "default") -> Dict[str, object]:
        """Reverse-call blast radius for one symbol (Directive F4).

        Directive G4: if this process has not ingested the package, the index
        is restored from the Zone C metadata the previous process wrote, so a
        restart answers without a re-parse.
        """
        indexer = self._indexers.get(str(namespace)) or self.indexer
        if indexer is None:
            indexer = CodeGraphIndexer.from_memory(self.model.memory, str(namespace))
            if indexer is not None:
                # Memoise the restored index. A sibling-lane mutation clears
                # it on the next read, so the memo cannot outlive the graph.
                self._indexers[str(namespace)] = indexer
        if indexer is None:
            raise ValueError("no code index in memory for this namespace")
        result = indexer.impact(target, hops=int(hops))
        result["namespace"] = str(namespace)
        if not result["resolved"]:
            result["vetoed"] = True
            result["callers"] = []
        else:
            result["vetoed"] = False
        return result

    # ------------------------------------------------------------- 2. solve
    def solve(
        self, source: str, operators: Sequence[str], namespace: str = "default"
    ) -> Dict[str, object]:
        result: SolveResult = self.solver.solve(source, operators, namespace=str(namespace))
        return {
            "answer": result.answer,
            "vetoed": bool(result.vetoed),
            "coherences": list(result.coherences),
            "text": self.decoder.render_path(result),
            "path": result.path,
            "namespace": str(namespace),
        }

    @torch.no_grad()
    def veto_check(self, task: str, x: torch.Tensor) -> Dict[str, float]:
        output = self.model(task, x, training=False)
        return {
            "veto_rate": float(output.veto.float().mean()),
            "s_max": float(output.s_max.mean()),
            "delta_sagnac": float(output.delta_sagnac.mean()),
            "confidence": float(output.margin.mean()),
        }

    # -------------------------------------------------------- 3. playbooks
    def _study_wave(self, text: str) -> np.ndarray:
        """A pure-phase study key: |key_d| is uniform, so unbinding is exact.

        compose() returns a chord whose component magnitudes vary between
        0.5 and 1.5. Unbinding with such a key leaves a random real
        amplitude mask, which destroys the recovered step phasors. The
        key is therefore projected onto the unit-modulus ring.
        """
        chord = self.codebook.compose(text, "operator", role=3, position=0.0)
        return _unit(np.exp(1j * np.angle(chord)))

    def compile_playbook(
        self,
        name: str,
        steps: Sequence[str],
        merge: bool = True,
        tier: int = 3,
        namespace: str = "default",
    ) -> Dict[str, float]:
        """Compile an execution strategy into a Tier-3 engram.

        The steps are superposed as psi_step * psi_pos^k, so the stored
        wave can unbind them one by one. merge=True appends new steps and
        drops duplicates, which is the ACE delta form: a strategy evolves
        without rewriting the whole record.
        """
        existing = self.playbooks.get(name)
        if merge and existing is not None:
            merged = list(existing.steps)
            for step in steps:
                if step not in merged:
                    merged.append(step)
            version = existing.version + 1
        else:
            merged = list(steps)
            version = 1 if existing is None else existing.version + 1
        for step in merged:
            self.codebook.add(str(step))
        position = self.codebook.position_wave()
        wave = np.zeros(self.cfg.dim, dtype=np.complex64)
        for index, step in enumerate(merged):
            wave = wave + self.codebook.symbol_wave(str(step)) * np.exp(
                1j * np.angle(position) * float(index)
            )
        wave = _unit(wave)
        key = self._study_wave(name)
        # Bind the key with a DC-biased payload, so retrieval is a plain
        # coherence match and the payload unbinds after the DC term is
        # removed. Nothing is generated: the steps are unit phasors.
        payload = 1.0 + 0.5 * wave.astype(np.complex64)
        stored = _unit(key * payload)
        from henri.holarch.zone_c import PLAYBOOK_LABEL_OFFSET

        record = self.model.memory.write(
            stored,
            label=PLAYBOOK_LABEL_OFFSET + int(version),
            tier=int(tier),
            namespace=str(namespace),
        )
        self.playbooks[name] = Playbook(name=name, steps=merged, version=version)
        self.note_state_change()
        return {
            "steps": float(len(merged)),
            "version": float(version),
            "engram_id": float(getattr(record, "engram_id", -1)),
            "tier": float(tier),
        }

    def recall_playbook(
        self, name: str, decode: bool = True, namespace: str = "default"
    ) -> Dict[str, object]:
        key = self._study_wave(name)
        # "__all__" is the explicit, audited cross-tenant read used only by
        # diagnostics; every request path passes a real namespace.
        scope = None if str(namespace) == "__all__" else str(namespace)
        read = self.model.memory.query(key, k=1, namespace=scope)
        if not read.hits:
            return {"found": 0.0, "steps": [], "text": "ABSTAIN: no playbook"}
        stored = np.asarray(read.top_wave if read.top_wave is not None else read.context)
        position = self.codebook.position_wave()
        steps: List[str] = []
        playbook = self.playbooks.get(name)
        exact = list(playbook.steps) if playbook is not None else []
        if decode:
            # stored = unit(key * (1 + a*w));  stored * conj(key) is
            # proportional to the payload, so normalise first, then remove
            # the DC bias, then unbind the position power of each step.
            residue = _unit(stored * np.conj(key))
            residue = _unit(residue - np.mean(residue))
            limit = max(1, len(exact)) if exact else 16
            for index in range(int(limit)):
                unbound = _unit(
                    residue * np.exp(-1j * np.angle(position) * float(index))
                )
                symbol, coherence, _ = self.codebook.snap(unbound)
                if coherence < 0.20:
                    break
                steps.append(symbol)
        return {
            "found": float(bool(read.hits)),
            "coherence": float(read.hits[0].coherence),
            "steps": exact,
            "decoded": steps,
            "text": self.decoder.render_plan(name, exact, verified=bool(read.hits)),
        }

    # -------------------------------------------------- 4. continual memory
    @torch.no_grad()
    def recall_prototype(self, task: str, x: torch.Tensor) -> Dict[str, object]:
        psi = self.model.encode(task, x)
        bright = self.model.zone_b(psi).bright
        bank = self.model.prototype_waves(task)
        if int(bank.numel()) == 0:
            return {"found": 0.0, "labels": [], "alignment": float("nan")}
        align = self.model.zone_b.alignment(bright, bank)
        best = align.argmax(dim=-1)
        labels = self.model.prototypes[task].labels
        return {
            "found": 1.0,
            "labels": [int(labels[int(index)]) for index in best],
            "alignment": float(align.max(dim=-1).values.mean()),
        }

    def adapt_rule(
        self,
        task: str,
        x: torch.Tensor,
        y: torch.Tensor,
        rule_id: Optional[int] = None,
        lr: float = 0.2,
    ) -> Dict[str, float]:
        """One surprise-gated fast-weight write, with the rule in slot 3."""
        with torch.no_grad():
            output = self.model(task, x, training=False, rule_id=rule_id)
            gate = self.model.plasticity_gate(output)
            self.model.fast_learn(output, y.long(), lr=float(lr))
        self.note_state_change()
        return {
            "gate_mean": float(gate.mean()),
            "surprise_mean": float(
                self.model.surprise(task, output.photonic.bright).mean()
            ),
            "examples": float(x.shape[0]),
        }

    # --------------------------------------------------------- 5. synthesis
    def synthesize(
        self,
        intent: str,
        kind: str = "code",
        namespace: str = "default",
        max_tokens: int = 320,
    ) -> Dict[str, object]:
        """Multi-token synthesis through the wave decoder (Stage 3).

        The engine is built once per service, because fitting the tokenizer,
        the projector and the count model is a corpus pass and not a request.
        """
        engine = self._ensure_engine(namespace)
        engine.namespace = str(namespace)
        self._engine.plans.namespace = str(namespace)
        result = self._engine.synthesize(intent, kind=str(kind), max_tokens=int(max_tokens))
        result["corpus"] = dict(getattr(self, "_engine_stats", {}))
        return result

    def _ensure_engine(self, namespace: str = "default"):
        """Return the WARM resident synthesis stack for one tenant (Q4).

        Directive Q4. The old method kept one slot and ignored the namespace,
        so a second tenant silently replaced the first, and a caller with no
        warm slot paid a corpus fit inside the request. The cache is keyed by
        (resolved root, namespace) and stamped with the state epoch; a code or
        vocabulary mutation clears it, and every other read is a dictionary
        hit.
        """
        key = (str(self.root.resolve()), str(namespace))
        cached = self._engines.get(key)
        if cached is not None and int(cached.get("epoch", -1)) == int(self._engine_epoch):
            self._engine = cached["engine"]
            self._engine_stats = cached["stats"]
            return self._engine
        from henri.holarch.code_gen import build_synthesis_engine

        symbols = set()
        signatures = {}
        indexer = self._indexers.get(str(namespace)) or self.indexer
        if indexer is not None:
            symbols |= indexer.symbol_names()
            signatures = dict(indexer.signatures)
        engine, stats = build_synthesis_engine(
            self.root,
            self.model.memory,
            namespace=str(namespace),
            symbol_table=symbols,
            signatures=signatures,
        )
        self._engines[key] = {
            "engine": engine,
            "stats": stats,
            "epoch": int(self._engine_epoch),
        }
        self._engine = engine
        self._engine_stats = stats
        return self._engine

    def _verify_vocabulary_claim(self, text: str, namespace: str = "default") -> Dict[str, object]:
        """Verify one locked token id against the deployed vocabulary (I1).

        The claim is a JSON object {"name": str, "token_id": int}. The answer
        is supported only when the engine's tokenizer is lock-backed, the
        name maps to exactly that id, and decoding the id returns the name.
        A fabricated name or a shifted id is refused, not approximated.
        """
        import json as _json

        try:
            payload = _json.loads(str(text))
        except Exception:
            return {
                "status": "unsupported",
                "supported": False,
                "reason": "a vocab claim must be a JSON object with name and token_id",
                "kind": "vocab",
                "claim": str(text),
                "namespace": str(namespace),
            }
        name = str(payload.get("name", "") or "")
        expected = payload.get("token_id")
        engine = self._ensure_engine(namespace)
        tokenizer = engine.tokenizer
        ledger = getattr(tokenizer, "ledger", None)
        actual = tokenizer.stoi.get(name)
        locked = bool(getattr(tokenizer, "locked", False))
        decoded = tokenizer.token_text(int(actual)) if actual is not None else ""
        supported = bool(
            locked
            and name
            and actual is not None
            and expected is not None
            and int(actual) == int(expected)
            and decoded == name
        )
        reason = (
            f"{name} keeps locked id {int(actual)}"
            if supported
            else (
                f"locked vocabulary mismatch for {name!r}: expected {expected}, "
                f"actual {actual}, locked={locked}"
            )
        )
        return {
            "status": "supported" if supported else "unsupported",
            "supported": bool(supported),
            "reason": reason,
            "kind": "vocab",
            "claim": str(text),
            "namespace": str(namespace),
            "token_id": int(actual) if actual is not None else None,
            "locked": locked,
            "ledger_digest": str(getattr(ledger, "digest", lambda: "")()) if ledger is not None else "",
            "vocabulary_size": int(len(tokenizer)),
        }

    def adapt_synthesis(
        self,
        intent: str,
        corrected_source: str,
        name: str,
        kind: str = "code",
        namespace: str = "default",
    ) -> Dict[str, object]:
        """Compile a verified fix into an ACE playbook for one tenant."""
        if self._engine is None:
            self.synthesize("warmup", kind="text", namespace=namespace)
        self._engine.namespace = str(namespace)
        self._engine.plans.namespace = str(namespace)
        result = self._engine.adapt(intent, corrected_source, name, kind=str(kind))
        self.note_state_change()
        return result

    # ------------------------------------------- planner + claim guard (H3)
    def _action_rotor(self, transition: str):
        rotor = getattr(self.model, "action_rotor", None)
        if str(transition) in {"rotor", "blend"} and rotor is None:
            raise ValueError(
                "the mounted checkpoint carries no fitted rotor; "
                "mount a Cycle H checkpoint or use transition='shift'"
            )
        return rotor

    def plan_choice(
        self,
        observation: Sequence[float],
        history_waves: Optional[Sequence[Sequence[float]]] = None,
        transition: str = "rotor",
        lookahead_depth: int = 2,
        gamma_look: float = 0.02,
        batch_rollout: bool = True,
        recent_waves: Optional[Sequence[torch.Tensor]] = None,
    ):
        """Return (lookahead, choice, recent) for the stateful API planner.

        Directive O2. The service keeps one episode trajectory per
        (namespace, episode_id); it calls this method so a cycle detection
        reads the same wave and the same legal mask the one-shot plan uses.
        When recent_waves is given it is used verbatim (already tensors);
        otherwise history_waves is decoded as before.
        """
        from henri.holarch.model import LatentActionLookahead

        rotor = self._action_rotor(transition)
        lookahead = LatentActionLookahead(
            self.model,
            None,
            rotor=rotor,
            transition=str(transition),
            lookahead_depth=int(lookahead_depth),
            gamma_look=float(gamma_look),
            batch_rollout=bool(batch_rollout),
        )
        if recent_waves is not None:
            recent = list(recent_waves)[-int(lookahead.history) :]
        else:
            recent = []
            for wave in list(history_waves or [])[-int(lookahead.history) :]:
                recent.append(_wave_tensor(wave, int(self.cfg.dim)))
        choice = lookahead.choose(observation, recent)
        return lookahead, choice, recent

    def plan(
        self,
        observation: Sequence[float],
        history_waves: Optional[Sequence[Sequence[float]]] = None,
        transition: str = "rotor",
        lookahead_depth: int = 2,
        gamma_look: float = 0.02,
        namespace: str = "default",
        batch_rollout: bool = True,
    ) -> Dict[str, object]:
        """Run the wall-masked depth-2 rotor lookahead on one observation.

        Directive H3. The planner is the object the 0.8125 win rate was
        measured with; it is now callable, and the rotor comes from the
        checkpoint rather than being refitted per request.
        """
        from henri.holarch.model import ACTION_NAMES

        lookahead, choice, recent = self.plan_choice(
            observation,
            history_waves=history_waves,
            transition=transition,
            lookahead_depth=lookahead_depth,
            gamma_look=gamma_look,
            batch_rollout=batch_rollout,
        )
        action = int(choice["action"])
        scores = choice["scores"]
        return {
            "action": action,
            "action_name": ACTION_NAMES[action % len(ACTION_NAMES)],
            "scores": [float(value) for value in scores],
            "alignment": [float(value) for value in choice["alignment"]],
            "penalty": [float(value) for value in choice["penalty"]],
            "lookahead": (
                [float(value) for value in choice["lookahead"]]
                if int(lookahead_depth) == 2
                else []
            ),
            "legal_mask": [bool(value) for value in choice["legal"]],
            "transition": str(transition),
            "lookahead_depth": int(lookahead_depth),
            "gamma_look": float(gamma_look),
            "history_waves": int(len(recent)),
            "batch_rollout": bool(batch_rollout),
            "namespace": str(namespace),
        }

    def verify_claim(
        self,
        claim: str,
        kind: str = "text",
        top_k: int = 4,
        namespace: str = "default",
    ) -> Dict[str, object]:
        """Check a prose claim against the corpus, or code against the AST.

        Directive H3. Text goes through the OntologyVerifier (rare terms and
        quantities must appear in the evidence). Code is parsed, compiled,
        and every callee is checked against the code index, so a fabricated
        signature is refused rather than accepted.
        """
        text = str(claim).strip()
        if str(kind) == "vocab":
            return self._verify_vocabulary_claim(text, namespace=str(namespace))
        if str(kind) == "text":
            verifier = self._ontology()
            verdict = verifier.verify_claim(text, top_k=int(top_k))
            payload = verdict.as_dict()
            payload["supported"] = bool(verdict.supported)
            payload["claim"] = text
            payload["kind"] = "text"
            payload["namespace"] = str(namespace)
            payload["corpus_digest"] = str(getattr(verifier, "corpus_digest", ""))
            return payload
        missing_terms: List[str] = []
        missing_numbers: List[str] = []
        try:
            tree = ast.parse(text)
        except SyntaxError as error:
            return {
                "status": "unsupported",
                "supported": False,
                "reason": f"ast.parse: {error.msg} at line {error.lineno}",
                "confidence": 0.0,
                "passages": [],
                "missing_terms": [],
                "missing_numbers": [],
                "kind": "code",
                "claim": text,
                "namespace": str(namespace),
            }
        try:
            compile(tree, "<verify>", "exec")
        except (SyntaxError, ValueError) as error:
            return {
                "status": "unsupported",
                "supported": False,
                "reason": f"compile: {error}",
                "confidence": 0.0,
                "passages": [],
                "missing_terms": [],
                "missing_numbers": [],
                "kind": "code",
                "claim": text,
                "namespace": str(namespace),
            }
        from henri.holarch.code_gen import ASTGate

        symbols = set()
        indexer = self._indexers.get(str(namespace)) or self.indexer
        if indexer is None:
            indexer = CodeGraphIndexer.from_memory(self.model.memory, str(namespace))
        if indexer is not None:
            symbols |= indexer.symbol_names()
        gate = ASTGate(symbols)
        for node in ast.walk(tree):
            if isinstance(node, ast.Call):
                # A method call (obj.method()) is not a global symbol. The
                # code index cannot enumerate every builtin container method,
                # and treating an Attribute callee as an unknown function
                # rejected valid solutions (Directive R4 co-processor audit).
                # Only a free Name callee is a claim about the module scope.
                name = node.func.id if isinstance(node.func, ast.Name) else ""
                if name and gate.symbol_veto(name):
                    missing_terms.append(name)
        if missing_terms:
            return {
                "status": "unsupported",
                "supported": False,
                "reason": f"callee(s) absent from the code index: {sorted(set(missing_terms))}",
                "confidence": 0.0,
                "passages": [],
                "missing_terms": sorted(set(missing_terms)),
                "missing_numbers": missing_numbers,
                "kind": "code",
                "claim": text,
                "namespace": str(namespace),
            }
        return {
            "status": "supported",
            "supported": True,
            "reason": "ast.parse and compile succeeded; every callee is indexed",
            "confidence": 1.0,
            "passages": [],
            "missing_terms": [],
            "missing_numbers": [],
            "kind": "code",
            "claim": text,
            "namespace": str(namespace),
        }

    def _ontology(self):
        cached = getattr(self, "_verifier_cache", None)
        if cached is not None:
            return cached
        if self._engine is not None and getattr(self._engine, "verifier", None) is not None:
            self._verifier_cache = self._engine.verifier
            return self._verifier_cache
        from henri.holarch.ontology_guard import build_verifier

        self._verifier_cache = build_verifier(self.root)
        return self._verifier_cache

    # ------------------------------------------------------------- lifecycle
    def report(self) -> Dict[str, float]:
        stats = self.model.memory.stats()
        return {
            "engrams": float(stats.get("count", 0.0)),
            "symbols": float(len(self.codebook)),
            "playbooks": float(len(self.playbooks)),
            "parameters": float(self.model.parameter_count()),
            "backend": float(1.0 if stats.get("backend") == "timescaledb" else 0.0),
        }

    def close(self) -> None:
        self.model.memory.close()
